response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), st AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM j GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandusagepct, SUM(n_tel) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(n_tel) / SUM(SUM(n_tel)) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage

assumptions.assumption: The total for the fraction is the number of telescopes that match an observatory (after dropping unmatched ones), not all rows in telescopes.
Stations whose telescopes all have a missing bandusagepct have a NULL station average. They are left out of the phase average but their telescopes still count toward the count and fraction.
